findings.summary: R1 milestone mapping includes M1 (Intake) but M1 deliverables do not cover recursive Markdown discovery implementation; M2 (Generate) is correct but M1 is premature.

evidence.note: R1 requires recursive discovery of .md files by default.
evidence.quote: The system MUST accept a user-specified local directory path as input and recursively discover Markdown files

evidence.note: M1 (Intake) focuses on confirming conventions/scale/IA/CLI shape and config schema, not implementing discovery.
evidence.quote: Intake: confirm conventions, scale, IA, and CLI shape (blockers)

evidence.note: M2 (Generate) includes DL6 Ingestion plugin implementing recursive discovery, which is the correct milestone for R1.
evidence.quote: Ingestion plugin implementing recursive discovery of .md files and creating note entries

findings.summary: R2 milestone mapping includes M1 (Intake) but M1 does not deliver static output generation; M2 (Generate) is correct but M1 is premature.

evidence.note: R2 requires static HTML/CSS/JS output with no server runtime.
evidence.quote: The system MUST generate a static build output consisting only of HTML, CSS, JavaScript

evidence.note: M1 (Intake) is a planning/confirmation milestone with no code deliverables for static output.
evidence.quote: Intake: confirm conventions, scale, IA, and CLI shape (blockers)

evidence.note: M2 (Generate) includes DL7 Emit plugin writing static site skeleton, which is the correct milestone for R2.
evidence.quote: Emit plugin writing a minimal static site skeleton (HTML/CSS/JS assets)

findings.summary: R3 milestone mapping includes M1 (Intake) but M1 does not deliver Markdown parsing or HTML generation; M2 (Generate) is correct but M1 is premature.

evidence.note: R3 requires CommonMark parsing and HTML page generation for each non-excluded Markdown file.
evidence.quote: The system MUST parse each discovered Markdown file using at least CommonMark-compliant syntax

evidence.note: M1 (Intake) is a planning/confirmation milestone with no code deliverables for parsing or rendering.
evidence.quote: Intake: confirm conventions, scale, IA, and CLI shape (blockers)

evidence.note: M3 (Validate) includes DL9 Markdown render plugin producing per-note HTML, which is the correct milestone for R3.
evidence.quote: Markdown render plugin producing per-note HTML pages for all non-excluded notes
